defs.def: connected with the inside of sth 内部的；里面的

ex.s: Now I go dipping almost every day, and I’ve come to long for that moment when the cold becomes a second skin and my internal voice goes silent.
ex.t: 现在我几乎每天都去游泳，我已经开始渴望那种寒冷成为第二层皮肤、内心声音变得安静的时刻。

defs.def: connected with the inside of your body 体内的

ex.s: FRESHWATER PROBLEMS in Africa by 2025 * Freshwater shortage (less than 1,000 m3/capita/year) * Freshwater stress (1,000 to 1,700 m3/capita/year) * Globally, renewable internal freshwater resource per capita was around 6,000 m3 in 2014.
ex.t: 到2025年非洲的淡水问题：淡水短缺、淡水压力、全球范围内2014年可再生内陆淡水资源人均约为6000立方米。

ex.s: Internal and external bleeding may also occur at this point.
ex.t: 此时也可能发生内外出血。

ex.s: So body language provides external that are influenced by internal thoughts and feelings.
ex.t: 所以肢体语言提供了受内在思想和情感影响的外在信号。

ex.s: These burns cause very severe internal injuries and the victim must go to the hospital at once.
ex.t: 这些烧伤会导致非常严重的内伤，受害者必须立即去医院。

ex.s: Chemical burns can even affect your internal if the chemicals are swallowed.
ex.t: 如果吞下化学物质，化学烧伤甚至会影响到你的内脏。

defs.def: involving or concerning only the people who are part of a particular organization rather than people from outside it （机构）内部的
connected with a country's own affairs rather than those that involve other countries 内政的；国内的
coming from within a thing itself rather than from outside it 本身的；自身的
happening or existing in your mind 内心的；头脑中的
